about.title: About
about.mayorTitle: Mayor of the City of Douala
about.doualais: Dear Doualais, Partners and Friends of Douala,
about.introduction1: Since 2020, Douala Fiesta has established itself as one of the most anticipated socio-cultural events in our city. This success reflects the vibrant soul of a city that refuses to limit its influence solely to its economic dimension.
about.introduction2: For Douala, the economic capital of Cameroon and the beating heart of the sub-region, is much more than a simple business hub: it is a place of encounters and cross-cultural exchanges, where languages, music, cuisines, traditions, and the ambitions of a country on the move intersect.
about.introduction3: This constant vitality carried with it one obvious need: an event capable of reflecting this energy, channeling it, and amplifying it. It is in this spirit that Douala Fiesta was born in 2020.
about.introduction4: Over the years, Douala Fiesta has charted a clear course: to embody both the vision of a city that aspires to be the cultural capital of Central Africa and the tangible impact of an event that transforms the daily lives of its residents.
about.introduction5: In 2026, we will take a decisive step forward by expanding to a main location for the first time, while maintaining a local presence through temporary activities in each district.
about.introduction6: Long live the Douala Fiesta Festival 2026! Long live Douala! Long live Cameroon!
about.point: In just five editions, our event has gone beyond mere entertainment:
about.point1: A space where our musicians meet their audiences and expand their reach
about.point2: A vibrant marketplace where our artisans and creators find new customers
about.point3: A platform where our businesses engage directly with thousands of consumers
about.point4: A unique moment where our families come together, share, and build shared memories
about.welcome: Welcome to the official website of Douala Fiesta Festival 2026, fourteen (14) days of fruitful celebration, culture and sharing in the heart of Douala.
about.dates: From December 19, 2026 to January 1, 2027, immerse yourself in a unique universe combining music, dance, gastronomy and local traditions.
about.missionText: To promote Cameroonian and African culture, strengthen community living and provide a space for entertainment, exchange and showcasing local talent.
about.team: Our team is committed and our values make this festival an essential driver of economic and cultural dynamism.
about.approach1: We take the time to understand the audience's needs to deliver an unforgettable experience
about.approach2: Each activity is unique and reflects the audience's personality
about.approach3: Careful coordination for an impeccable result
about.miss: more than a competition, Miss Douala Fiesta reveals ambassadors of the city and its values.
about.heroes: Douala's talents, neighborhood hope, inspiration for all.
about.funActivities: laughter, games, and camaraderie: a place where every child can have fun!
about.shows: the Douala Fiesta show brings together headliners and young talents through themed concerts (religious, folk, old school, youth, and urban) for a rich, varied, and festive experience open to all.
about.sales: at the Exhibition-Sale Village Douala showcases its talent! Gastronomic Varieties, Artisans, creators, and businesses invite you to explore, meet, and create new opportunities.
